Rint the Archer

Overview

Rint is a village archer initially bound by his duty to the captain. When he is free to decide for himself, he can accompany Zak. He is confident in his marksmanship, prefers a small travelling party and wishes Zak well when the journey takes him to other lands. [1, 2, 3, 4]

Recruitment and farewell

Zak first notices Archer’s marksmanship and proposes that he join his expeditions. Archer initially answers that he reports to the captain. A later conversation establishes that he can now decide for himself and is willing to join. This change explains his availability; it does not imply that he accompanies every expedition. At their farewell, Zak thanks him for his aim, and Archer hopes he will find equally capable help abroad. [1, 2, 5, 6, 3, 4, 7]
